response.sql: WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT orders.timespan, COUNT(*) as bucket_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as bucket_share FROM riskandmargin INNER JOIN orders ON riskandmargin.ordervault = orders.recordvault GROUP BY orders.timespan), with_average AS (SELECT bucket_count, bucket_share, AVG(bucket_share) OVER () as average_share FROM bucket_counts), filtered_buckets AS (SELECT bucket_count, bucket_share, average_share FROM with_average WHERE bucket_share > average_share) SELECT SUM(bucket_count) as total_count, AVG(bucket_share) as average_share, AVG(bucket_share - average_share) as above_average_amount FROM filtered_buckets
